description: GET /interview-prep/{interviewPrepId} - Get interview prep status or result

questions.text: Tell me about a time when you had to optimize a system serving millions of users. What was your approach and what were the results?

suggested_answer.situation: At TechCorp, our API was experiencing latency issues with response times averaging 500ms, impacting 5M+ daily active users.
suggested_answer.task: I was tasked with reducing API response time by at least 30% while maintaining system stability.
suggested_answer.action: I conducted a comprehensive performance audit, implemented strategic caching with Redis, optimized database indexes, and refactored N+1 queries.
suggested_answer.result: Reduced API response time by 40% (from 500ms to 300ms), improved user satisfaction scores by 25%.
